card.name: The letter H starting a word
card.fires_on: The letter h or H (or a split-off 'H' piece) that begins an h-word such as hymns, hewers, HLA, HbA1c, hate or hazy. It often sits right after a space, quote or hyphen, or inside a compound like Homonym/homophone.

modes.description: A capital H opens a medical abbreviation or all-caps word.
